response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, n, 100.0 * n / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean of per-observatory shares across observatories that have at least one telescope (observatories with no telescopes do not appear in the telescopes table and are excluded).
Each row in telescopes is one telescope, so counting rows per observstation gives the telescope count.

alternatives.interpretation: The average share is taken across all observatories in the observatories table, including those with zero telescopes (share 0), so the threshold is 100/number of observatories.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS n FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, n, 100.0 * n / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
